description: This file defines the ConnectionConfig interface which provides configuration settings for the connectivity service's connection behavior, including protocol-specific configurations, hostname whitelisting/blacklisting, timeouts, and snapshotting behaviors.

classes.name: ConnectionConfig
classes.description: An interface providing various configuration options for establishing and managing connectivity, protocols, timeouts, and acknowledgement behaviors.

classes.name: ConnectionConfig.ConnectionConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining known configuration path expressions and their default values for ConnectionConfig, enhancing configuration management.

methods.name: getClientActorAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration that the connection actor waits for responses from client actors. Default is high to accommodate long connection establishment times.

methods.name: getAllowedHostnames
methods.description: Provides a collection of hostnames allowed for outgoing connections, overriding blocked hostnames if set.

methods.name: getBlockedHostnames
methods.description: Provides a collection of hostnames that outgoing connection attempts are prevented from reaching, including private and multicast addresses when listing is nonempty.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration related to connection snapshotting behavior.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementConfig
methods.description: Provides the configuration settings specific to acknowledgements for connections.

methods.name: getAmqp10Config
methods.description: Returns protocol-specific configuration for AMQP 1.0 protocol.

methods.name: getAmqp091Config
methods.description: Returns protocol-specific configuration for AMQP 0.9.1 protocol, available since version 1.2.0.

methods.name: getMqttConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration specific to the MQTT protocol.

methods.name: getHttpPushConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration for HTTP push connection type.

methods.name: getAckLabelDeclareInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration for how often acknowledgement labels are declared when not successful.
